title: Activating and Deactivating Virtual Environments
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of activating and deactivating virtual environments.

content.intro: This lesson introduces activating and deactivating virtual environments as part of virtual environments, dependencies, and packaging. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Organize reusable code and its dependencies deliberately. Test from the project root, pin or constrain dependencies intentionally, and document supported Python versions.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A virtual environment isolates project-installed packages from the base interpreter’s site packages.

content_blocks.title: How to work with it
content_blocks.text: For activating and deactivating virtual environments, identify the inputs and assumptions first. Use the smallest useful example, predict its behavior, run it in a local Python interpreter, and compare the observed result with your prediction.
